description: Machine-readable binding registry for the SRAI operator dispatch surface. Each operator maps an AIML SRAI target to a typed XCFE dispatch frame. SraiOperators.mml is the human-readable contract authority.

pipeline.description: SCORE → RANK → COLLAPSE → VERIFY → TRAIN → Xul commit. No operator may shortcut to Xul without traversing Ch'en verification.

weight_invariant.W_corpus: read-only; set by scraper pipeline; never overwritten by TRAIN
weight_invariant.W_learned: mutable; updated only after Ch'en_verification AND Xul_authorization

trace.law: every hop is recorded before the child text is emitted; an operator with no host dispatch records dispatch:unbound and remains a proposal, never a granted operation

fields.srai: one {target, depth, child, matched, status} per redirect
fields.children: the nested child trace; parent on the child equals the parent trace id
fields.xcfe: one {op, admitted, authority, dispatch} per operator node; admitted is false for this engine

operators.description: Evaluates W·C·R, vector similarity, and metric evidence for each candidate. Populates evidence field for RANK. Does not select or admit.
Orders the admitted scored_candidates set. XCFE legality is a separate hard gate; high rank cannot promote an inadmissible candidate.
Proposes candidates for a gap. Proposing is not ranking, selecting or admitting: the output is a candidate set, and XCFE legality remains a separate hard gate.

operators.note: Greymarch_record_only; Xul commit requires full authority path
operators.description: Total-order reduction via Jyggalag (T=0.00). Produces Greymarch record naming the surviving candidate. Not a topology commit. Sheogorath/Jyggalag must appear as a matched unit.

pair_constraint.law: Sheogorath generates the high-entropy candidate set that COLLAPSE reduces

operators.description: The Ch'en verification gate. verified_outcome is the only input that unlocks TRAIN. Does not commit; produces a gate token required by both TRAIN and Xul.
operators.gate_law: TRAIN dispatch is blocked (XCFE TRAIN UNVERIFIED) without verified_outcome from this operator

operators.description: Proposes W_learned delta from verified feedback. Requires verified_outcome from VERIFY/Ch'en and Xul_authorization. W_corpus is never overwritten.
operators.srai_guard_reason: TRAIN may not run without a verified outcome reference, so the executable surface accepts only the guarded form; `TRAIN *` was never the dispatched pattern

operators.description: Structured comparison of two candidates or evidence sets. Output feeds evidence_refs for VERIFY.
GramStore + vector evidence retrieval. Output feeds scored_candidates or evidence_refs into the SCORE→RANK pipeline.
VectorMuMicronaut geodesic projection. Returns a new bounded result substrate without mutating the target. Zero pattern inflation.
Reads a published app manifest from the manifest_store. Public apps are accessible without a session; private apps require an owner session. Output feeds PATCH pipelines.
Enumerates all projects owned by the session user. Returns project_index from the per-user storage directory.
Publishes a new asx.mini-app.v1 manifest to the per-user project store and updates the app_index. Requires valid session and a manifest whose @kind is asx.mini-app.v1.
Applies a JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) to an existing app manifest. Only the owner session may patch; the patch is applied to doc.manifest and re-saved atomically.

operators.srai_guard_reason: Mirrors TRAIN guard: DELETE without an owner session and Ch'en verification is structurally blocked at the AIML surface before the Xul path opens
operators.description: Removes a project from the per-user store and from the app_index. Owner + Ch'en verification + Xul authorization all required before the deletion receipt is issued.
Question selector; drives clarification and intent-gap filling. Learned preferences keyed as q_pref:<gap_id>:<pattern> in GramStore.

The unit of the endomorphism monoid over FoldState: returns the state it was given. effects is empty because nothing happens, and phase_policy=preserve because a no-op inside a phase is not a phase transition. Use ADVANCE_PHASE to move the phase.
operators.aiml_surface_reason: no AIML dispatch category yet; the operator is reachable only through the XCFE executor surface

operators.description: The unit of vector/tensor transformation composition. Preserves the substrate and the phase; it never stands in for a projection or a transition.
operators.aiml_surface_reason: no AIML dispatch category yet; the operator is reachable only through the XCFE executor surface

operators.note: The target phase is resolved at dispatch time; a cross-phase step still passes through XCFEExecutor::authorize_phase_transition and FoldEngine::vertical_fold enforces a single primitive step.
operators.description: The only operator with phase authority. It requests the next phase in the K'UHUL cycle (Pop->Wo->Yax->Sek->Ch'en->Xul); it does not grant it. This is why IDENTITY_STATE cannot be used to advance: an identity preserves the phase, and only an explicit request crosses a boundary.
operators.aiml_surface_reason: no AIML dispatch category yet; phase advance is requested through XCFE, never by pattern

pipeline_patterns.description: Full pre-verification pipeline without premature TRAIN
The only safe TRAIN path — forces verification before learning
Read-modify-write: fetch current manifest then apply a merge patch
Publish and immediately read back the stored manifest

invariants: SRAI redirects text through the pattern matcher; XCFE dispatch requires the [XCFE:OP] binding frame in the template
Every operator declares phase, executor, input_roles, output_role, and effects before dispatch
TRAIN requires verified_outcome from Ch'en; raw RANK output alone does not authorize learning
W_effective = W_corpus * W_learned; W_corpus is read-only; TRAIN updates only W_learned
COLLAPSE produces a Greymarch record; it is not a topology commit
No operator can shortcut to Xul without traversing the Ch'en verification gate
effects must be a subset of {read, measure, order, analyze, gate, project, emit, collapse, propose_delta, transition}
Operators with propose_delta in effects must declare commit_requires fields

Every operator declares algebra_ref resolving to exactly one Algebraic Operator ISA entry (data/grammar/algebra-isa.contracts.json); the AOI entry is what licenses regroup, reorder, distribute, repeat and invert
effects containing transition iff the AOI entry declares phase_policy=advance; an identity operator preserves the phase and may never be used to cross one
This registry describes operator contracts; aiml_engine.cpp + xcfe_executor.cpp supply the implementation
App tool operators (APP_GET, APP_LIST, APP_POST, APP_PATCH, APP_DELETE) carry semantic_authority=false and topology_mutation=false in every dispatch frame
APP_DELETE requires the GUARD step before XCFE APP DELETE, mirroring TRAIN's guard law; DELETE APP WITHOUT AUTH is the named blocked pattern
APP_POST and APP_PATCH are Xul-phase writes; APP_GET and APP_LIST are Pop-phase reads — no app read op requires Xul authorization
Natural language aliases (OPEN/SHOW → GET, CREATE/PUBLISH → POST, UPDATE/EDIT → PATCH, REMOVE → DELETE) are surface redirects only; the XCFE dispatch frame is always the canonical form

aiml.freshness_rule: the live AIML operator and XCFE-pattern inventory must equal these lists, so a stale surface is detectable
